task: Listing projects: after a project is created with `POST /api/project.create` (a `name` and a `description`), `GET /api/project.all` with the API key answers 200 with a JSON array that contains that project, with its `projectId`, `name` and `description` as created.

Updating a project: `POST /api/project.update` with a `projectId`, a new `name` and a new `description` answers 200 with the updated project, whose `name` and `description` are the new values, and `GET /api/project.one?projectId=<id>` afterwards returns the same new values.

Every new project has one default environment: right after `POST /api/project.create`, `GET /api/environment.byProjectId?projectId=<id>` answers 200 with an array holding exactly one environment, named `production`, whose `isDefault` is true.

The API key identifies its organization: `GET /api/user.session` with a valid `x-api-key` answers 200 with a `session.activeOrganizationId` equal to the `id` of the organization that `GET /api/organization.all` returns, while the same request without the header, or with an invalid key, answers 401.

A new application record is idle because nothing was deployed: after `POST /api/application.create` (a `name`, a `description` and the `environmentId` of a project's environment), `GET /api/application.one?applicationId=<id>` answers 200 with the same `name`, `description` and `environmentId` and with `applicationStatus` equal to `idle`. Never deploy or start the application; remove it afterwards with `POST /api/application.delete`.
